title_as_printed: Mean solubility values and corresponding absorption coefficients
pressure_note: each result expressed at 760 mm Hg (corrected to 0 C, sea level and 45 degrees latitude) in equilibrium with air saturated with water vapour (total pressure 760 mm Hg)

value.what: mean of 207 results at 18 temperatures, mg oxygen per litre of solution measured at room temperature (about 20 C), air-saturated at 760 mm

value2.what: absorption coefficient beta = C_s/(0.39390 (760-p)) from authors' eq. (1), p = vapour pressure of water

volume_basis_evidence: 'the absorption coefficients are calculated for solutions measured at room temperature'; solubility in 'mg./l.'; titrations at room temperature (about 20 C) with no thermal-expansion correction
extra_unmapped: absorption coefficient is calculated, not measured
conversion_needs: mg/l solution measured at about 20 C to a mole fraction needs solution density at 20 C; air composition 20.95 % O2 used in eq. (1) (0.2095)
notes: Printed as two side-by-side blocks (left 0.38-20.00, right 22.50-37.00); stacked left block first, then right. Printed decimal points were mid-dots; written with full stops. Text layer wrote some thousand separators as commas (13,397; 12,422): fixed from image.
